selectedAssets.alt: Four fictional adult women in short copper-blue, lilac, red-ivory, and emerald RAZE looks wear colorful knee-high hosiery and heels outside Helsinki's Oodi Library as the woman at left kisses the blonde woman.

Four fictional adult women in black-bronze, blue-amber, magenta-silver, and teal RAZE looks wear distinct sculptural knee-high boots on Turku's Aura River promenade while the woman at right kisses her neighbor's cheek.
Four fictional adult women in short copper, pearl, turquoise-ivory, and plum-green RAZE looks wear colorful knee-high boots in Tampere's Finlayson courtyard as the two women at left share a kiss.

Four fictional adult women in short teal-silver, pearl-gold, burgundy-pale-blue, and cobalt-emerald RAZE looks stand closely linked in colorful knee-high boots on a timber terrace above Koli's forested lake islands.
